law_record.title: School zone or school crossing zone (2)
law_record.text: A person shall not drive a motor vehicle at a speed in excess of 25 miles per hour in an area designated as a school crossing zone except: (a) On a day on which school is not in session; (b) During the period from a half hour after school is no longer in operation to a half hour before school is next in operation; (c) If the zone is designated by an operational speed limit beacon, during the hours when the pupils of the school are in class and the yellow lights of the speed limit beacon are not flashing in the manner which indicates that the speed limit is in effect; or (d) If the zone is not designated by an operational speed limit beacon, during the times when the sign designating the school zone indicates that the speed limit is not in effect. As used in this section, “speed limit beacon” means a device which is used in conjunction with a sign and equipped with two or more yellow lights that flash alternately to indicate when the speed limit in a school zone or school crossing zone is in effect.

activation_conditions: the subject is in an area designated as a school crossing zone
the zone's speed limit is in effect
exceptions: on a day on which school is not in session
from half an hour after school is no longer in operation to half an hour before it is next in operation
where the zone has an operational speed limit beacon, during class hours when the beacon's yellow lights are not flashing
where the zone has no operational beacon, during the times the zone sign says the limit is not in effect
residue: 'school is in session' and 'school hours' are legal/calendar classes, not atoms: reading assumptions declared per trace
the beacon's flashing state is the one observable form of the condition; without it the rule reports unknown
